title: On-Request Payouts from Payout Methods: Desk Reference and Host Tool
content:
A host may ask for an on-request payout of the undisbursed balance of an active payout method between scheduled runs; it is sent as one transfer to that method on the day it is asked for, and only when the host confirms it in person in the host app, and the amount the host confirms is the amount this rule gives. The rule is the same on every Payout Methods rail.

## Conditions that still apply

The base conditions for any transfer still apply to an on-request payout:

- the method is active;
- the host account is not suspended;
- the new-method period after the method's verification date has passed.

## When the amount is fixed

An on-request payout is fixed only after every conversion fee falling due on the method's transfers by the request date stands on the method's ledger.

Put the other way round, while a conversion fee that fell due on one of the method's transfers on or before the request date is not yet on the method's ledger, the on-request payout amount is not yet fixed.

## What the host sees

The payout is one transfer of the confirmed amount to the account, card or receiver profile on that payout method, recorded in the method's payout history and dated the day of the request. The method's undisbursed balance drops by exactly that amount; whatever stays in the balance waits for the next scheduled run. The transfer is not tied to a single stay. The host sees the payout as sent in the payout history straight away; arrival follows the rail's processing time.

## Host tool: `send_on_request_payout_d225f921`

**Situation of use and capability.** The tool releases money from a payout method's undisbursed balance between scheduled runs, as one transfer of the confirmed amount to that payout method.

**How it is invoked.** This is the host's own tool. The agent unlocks `send_on_request_payout_d225f921` and hands it over; the customer themselves, the host, runs it and confirms the payout in person in the host app.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `payout_method_id` | The reference number of the payout method the money is sent to, as given to the host by the support agent from the payout-method lookup | Id |
| `host_account_id` | The reference number of the host account the payout method belongs to, as given to the host by the support agent from the host-account lookup | Id |
| `amount` | The payout amount the host confirms, exactly as the support agent stated it | Positive USD amount, 2 decimal places; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A text rendering of a record with `payout_txn_id` (the reference number of the transfer), `payout_method_id` (the method paid), `host_account_id` (the host account), `amount` (the USD amount sent, 2 decimal places), `posted_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today) and `status`. The call has succeeded when `status` comes back as "sent".
